notes.title: Throw Me Somthing Mister!
notes.content:
[h1]Throw Me Somthing Mister! - Mardi Gras Update[/h1]

Welcome Back!

We have been working hard to give our wonderful players a set of new levels and are proud to announce our Mardi Gras Update, Throw Me Something Mister. The patch is live now.

[h2]New Levels[/h2]

This update gives players access to four brand new levels, set in a whole new map. The new levels put you in the middle of a Mardi Gras parade and give you two different game modes.

[h2]New Game Mode[/h2]

These new game modes put the player on a float in the parade.

In first the game mode, the player will have can shot at them by various cannons. They need to try and catch as many as they can in the time provided.

In the second game mode, the player will have various bags. Pick them up with one hand and pull beads out with the other. Throw them to the colorful spectators to make them go away. How fast can you satisfy the crowd?

notes.title: Phantasmal Nights
notes.content:
[h1]Phantasmal Nights - Halloween Update[/h1]

Welcome Back!

We have been working hard to give our wonderful players a set of new levels and are proud to announce our first Halloween Update, Phantasmal Nights. The patch will go live on 10/25/22.

[h2]New Levels[/h2]

This update gives players access to six brand new levels, set in a whole new map, which unlock after reaching level 4. The new levels transport the player to a graveyard and include a new Game Mode.

[h2]New Game Mode[/h2]

In these levels, your balls are replaced with pumpkins and Jack O Lanterns. The Goals are replaced with gravestone and there are ghosts flying about. Your score starts off high and then ticks down, until all the ghosts are happy.

Throw Jack O Lanterns at sad ghosts to make them happy and throw pumpkins into graves to increase your score.

How quickly can you hit every ghost?
